title: New listing matching your search
description: Alert saved-search leads when a new property matches their criteria. Marketing WhatsApp template with price, size and link.
notes: Reference the criteria the user saved so it feels relevant, and keep the opt-out. Include price and bedrooms for scannability.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, a new listing matches your search: *{{bedrooms}} bed in {{neighborhood}}* for {{price}}. It just came on the market and viewings are filling up fast.
